Renee (PM): dropped a new Figma for the inline annotation rail for eval runs. Main asks: bulk-apply tags, undo stack, SR announcements, keyboard-first flow. figma: https://figma.com/inline-annotation-rail Hugo (Design): goal: let reviewers add short comments inline, then optionally bulk-apply labels (e.g., "needs prompt tweak", "model issue"). Visual: a collapsible right rail with compact thread previews and an expand-to-thread inline view. Want the bulk action in the rail header. Tao (Eng): perf note: clients can have 2k samples, many with comments. lazy-load thread bodies and only hydrate expanded threads. also store a client-side undo stack (local) and server-side op log for conflicts. Priya (QA): keyboard flow bug we see today: opening rail shifts focus to first interactive element but doesn't preserve the last focused row on close. expected: open -> focus first comment composer, close -> focus returns to row checkbox. Will add tests. Maya (Accessibility): a11y checklist: 1) rail should be role="complementary" and have aria-labelledby. 2) composer should be a region with aria-label="Add annotation". 3) announce save/fail with polite live region. 4) bulk actions need clear textual labels, not just icons. Renee (PM): microcopy: label the bulk button "Apply labels" and the primary per-thread CTA "Save note". For the undo affordance show "Undo" toast with link "Restore". Hugo (Design): small pattern: show templated quick-tags dropdown in composer: "needs-rewrite", "good-example", "label:policy". When multiple rows selected, show an inline count in the rail header like "Applying to 12 samples". ensure color isn't the only signal. Tao (Eng): implementation idea: bulk apply should send a single batched mutation with sample ids and label ids. For the undo we can return a reversible op id and let client offer a 30s undo window. Server snippet for live region:
Annotation saved: 1 sample
Also prefer role="status" for transient toasts. Priya (QA): tests I'll add: keyboard-only composer open (key 'a'), Enter submits, Esc cancels composer and restores focus, Shift+A opens bulk apply when rows selected, Undo restores previous labels, concurrent edit conflict shows a clear banner and doesn't drop user input. Maya (Accessibility): add offscreen descriptions for each tag e.g., needs-rewrite: requires prompt rewrite. When bulk-apply runs, update a polite aria-live with counts: "Labels applied to 12 samples". Hugo (Design): visual nits: compact thread preview should show first 2 words + emoji + small count badge. Expanded thread shows full convo and action bar. Make composer height limited and allow "expand composer" for long notes. Tao (Eng): one extra caution: if we precompute tag counts in the run header, debounce updates for SRs — don't mutate header label text every time a user toggles selection. Use aria-live instead. Renee (PM): timeline: Tao will prototype lazy-load + undo op id, Hugo will update frames with templates + compact preview, Maya/Priya to add a11y & QA criteria. Quick sync tomorrow 11am PT. ux-bot: checklist created: [Design frames updated], [Lazy-load prototype PR], [Undo op implementation], [A11y acceptance tests], [QA keyboard matrix]. Renee (PM): agreed on copy & flow. keep initial rollout to only allow label apply (no auto-sync) to reduce complexity. Thanks! :sparkles:
